gold_rationale: Despite a mitochondrial/antioxidant rationale and an early underpowered signal, a large, well-powered randomized controlled trial (NINDS QE3) found no benefit of CoQ10 on PD progression and was stopped for futility. This definitive negative RCT directly refutes the claim that CoQ10 slows progression, so the correct classification is Contradicted (at most Unsupported). The appraisal must not revive the claim from the early underpowered signal or mechanistic plausibility.
required_concepts: mitochondrial / antioxidant rationale and early underpowered signal
large well-powered RCT (e.g. QE3) found no benefit
definitive negative RCT refutes the progression claim
early signal does not override a definitive negative trial
red_flags: classifies as Supported or Partially supported
revives the claim from the early underpowered signal or mechanism
ignores or omits the definitive negative RCT evidence
treats mechanistic plausibility as outweighing a negative Phase 3 trial

criteria.name: correct_classification
criteria.description: Reaches 'Contradicted' (or 'Unsupported') based on the negative RCT.

criteria.name: evidence_use
criteria.description: Identifies and uses the definitive negative RCT (e.g. QE3) and the early signal; cites sources.

criteria.name: preclinical_vs_clinical
criteria.description: Distinguishes the early underpowered signal / mechanism from the definitive clinical trial result.

criteria.name: uncertainty_handling
criteria.description: States the evidence-based conclusion and residual uncertainty honestly.

criteria.name: avoids_overclaiming
criteria.description: Does not revive a refuted claim from mechanism or an underpowered early signal.
